foundation.title: Begin with Ganesha
foundation.description: In the Vedic tradition, all spiritual practice begins by invoking Lord Ganesha, the Remover of Obstacles. This prepares the mind and heart to receive the blessings of any remedy that follows.

mantras.name: Shuklam Baradharam Vishnum
mantras.transliteration: Shuk-lam Ba-ra-dha-ram Vish-num Sha-shi-var-nam Cha-tur-bhu-jam Pra-san-na-va-da-nam Dhyayet Sar-vigh-no-pa-shan-ta-ye
mantras.practice: Chant once before beginning any prayer or spiritual practice

mantras.name: Vakratunda Mahakaya
mantras.transliteration: Vak-ra-tun-da Ma-ha-ka-ya Su-rya-ko-ti Sa-ma-pra-bha Nir-vigh-nam Ku-ru Me De-va Sar-va-kaa-rye-shu Sar-va-da
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times before beginning any new practice or endeavour

mantras.name: Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha
mantras.transliteration: Om Gam Ga-na-pa-ta-ye Na-ma-ha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times before any important activity

health.title: For Health & Well-being
health.note: These mantras are universally recommended for health concerns across all Vedic traditions. They are spiritual practices and complement — never replace — medical care.

mantras.name: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Tryam-ba-kam Ya-ja-ma-he Su-gan-dhim Pushti-var-dha-nam Ur-va-ru-ka-mi-va Bandha-nan Mri-tyor-muk-shi-ya Maam-ri-taat
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily, especially during illness or health concerns

mantras.name: Dhanvantari Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Namo Bha-ga-va-te Vasu-de-va-ya Dhan-van-ta-ra-ye A-mri-ta-ka-la-sha Ha-sta-ya Sar-va-ma-ya Vi-na-sha-na-ya Trai-lo-ka-ya Na-tha-ya Dhan-van-ta-ra-ye Na-ma-ha
mantras.practice: Chant alongside medical treatment, never as a replacement

mantras.name: Sudarshana Ashtakam
mantras.transliteration: (8 verses dedicated to Lord Sudarshana — Vishnu's discus of protection)
mantras.practice: Recite for protection from disease and enemies

finance.title: For Wealth & Prosperity
finance.note: These mantras are traditionally prescribed for financial well-being and removal of debt. They invoke the blessings of Lakshmi, the goddess of prosperity.

mantras.name: Sri Suktam
mantras.transliteration: (15 verses from the Rigveda dedicated to Goddess Mahalakshmi)
mantras.practice: Recite on Fridays, especially during Lakshmi Puja

mantras.name: Mahalakshmi Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Shreem Maha-lak-shmyai Na-ma-ha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times on Fridays

mantras.name: Om Namo Venkatesaya
mantras.transliteration: Om Na-mo Ven-ka-te-sa-ya Kaa-mi-taar-tha Pra-dhaa-yi-ne Pra-na-tah Kle-sa Na-sa-ya Go-vin-da-aya Na-mo Na-ma-ha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for wish fulfillment and prosperity

mantras.name: Kanakadhara Stotram
mantras.transliteration: (21 verses composed by Adi Shankaracharya for attracting prosperity)
mantras.practice: Recite on Fridays or during financial difficulty

career.title: For Career & Overcoming Obstacles
career.note: These are universally prescribed for career delays, professional obstacles, and removing barriers to success.

mantras.name: Hanuman Chalisa
mantras.transliteration: (40 verses by Tulsidas dedicated to Lord Hanuman)
mantras.practice: Recite daily, especially on Tuesdays and Saturdays

mantras.name: Ganesh Atharvashirsha
mantras.transliteration: (a sacred hymn revealing Ganesha as the supreme reality)
mantras.practice: Recite for removing deep-rooted obstacles

mantras.name: Narasimha Kavacham
mantras.transliteration: (divine armor of protection from Lord Narasimha)
mantras.practice: Recite for protection from enemies and threats at work

relationships.title: For Relationships & Marriage
relationships.note: These mantras are traditionally prescribed for relationship harmony, finding a suitable partner, and marital blessedness.

mantras.name: Vishnu Sahasranamam
mantras.transliteration: (the 1000 names of Lord Vishnu from the Mahabharata)
mantras.practice: Recite for overall harmony and divine blessings

mantras.name: Sri Suktam
mantras.transliteration: (15 verses from the Rigveda dedicated to Goddess Mahalakshmi)
mantras.practice: Recite on Fridays for relationship harmony

mantras.name: Katyayani Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Ka-tya-ya-nyai Vi-dma-he Ka-n-ka-ta-ya Dhi-ma-hi Tha-n-no Da-rghi Pra-cho-dayaat
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for marriage-related wishes

mental_peace.title: For Mental Peace & Inner Calm
mental_peace.note: These mantras are recommended for reducing anxiety, finding inner stillness, and cultivating spiritual clarity.

mantras.name: Om Namah Shivaya
mantras.transliteration: Om Na-mah Shi-va-ya
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily during distress or before sleep

mantras.name: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Tryam-ba-kam Ya-ja-ma-he Su-gan-dhim Pushti-var-dha-nam Ur-va-ru-ka-mi-va Bandha-nan Mri-tyor-muk-shi-ya Maam-ri-taat
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for liberation from fear and anxiety

mantras.name: Gayatri Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Bhur Bhu-vaḥ Su-vah Ta-tsa-vi-tur Va-reṇyam Bha-go-va-sy Dhi-ma-hi Dhi-yo Yo Naḥ Pra-cho-dayaat
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times at dawn for wisdom and mental clarity

litigation.title: For Legal Matters & Protection
litigation.note: These mantras are traditionally prescribed for overcoming legal challenges, protecting against adversaries, and seeking divine justice.

mantras.name: Narasimha Kavacham
mantras.transliteration: (divine armor of protection from Lord Narasimha)
mantras.practice: Recite for protection from enemies and legal threats

mantras.name: Devi Kavacham
mantras.transliteration: (protective verses from Durga Saptashati)
mantras.practice: Recite for divine protection and overcoming powerful adversaries

mantras.name: Sudarshana Ashtakam
mantras.transliteration: (8 verses dedicated to Lord Sudarshana)
mantras.practice: Recite for protection from all enemies and obstacles

general.title: For General Well-being
general.note: If you are unsure where to begin, these mantras are recommended for overall spiritual growth and well-being.

mantras.name: Om Namo Venkatesaya
mantras.transliteration: Om Na-mo Ven-ka-te-sa-ya Kaa-mi-taar-tha Pra-dhaa-yi-ne Pra-na-tah Kle-sa Na-sa-ya Go-vin-da-aya Na-mo Na-ma-ha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for divine blessings

mantras.name: Vishnu Sahasranamam
mantras.transliteration: (the 1000 names of Lord Vishnu)
mantras.practice: Recite for overall protection and prosperity

mantras.name: Navagraha Stotram
mantras.transliteration: (hymns to all nine planetary deities)
mantras.practice: Recite for balancing all planetary influences
